verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS equity-management platform with an API and an MCP integration, so letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry opt-out, usage-tracking control, or analytics setting. The community complaints about cap-table data being used for sales outreach concern data misuse, not a user-facing opt-out control, so they establish no capability.
